name: @telorun/host-runner
description: Telo Host Runner - serves the /v1 runner API over local processes, so an editor (or any client) can run applications on this machine. Bundles the telo it runs on.
author: Bartosz Pasiński <bartosz.pasinski@codenet.pl>

scripts.prepack: node ../../scripts/pack-backup.mjs . --save dist package.json && tsc && cp ../../LICENSE . && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --out THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES && node ../../scripts/prepack-bake-overrides.mjs . && node ../../scripts/rewrite-pack-links.mjs .
